The '''Test of the Droids''' was a short battle that occurred in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Edic Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Genarius]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While preparing to hold some [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] for students of the [[Almas Academy]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] dispatched a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] members of the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to collect some [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] components from [[Snem Noonb]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who operated a manufacturing facility on Edic Bar. As a test for the [[Agent/Legends|agents]], Qel-Bertuk conspired with Noonb to organize a "Test of the Droids", whereby Noonb would program a number of droids to stage a mock droid revolt after the heroes arrived. However, an agent of the Genarius-based criminal [[Zelice Sturm]] secretly re-programmed the droids to stage a genuine uprising that was beyond the control of Noonb. The heroes successfully defeated the droids, and Noonb contacted Qel-Bertuk, to inform him that the droids had been tampered with.

==Behind the scenes==
The Test of the Droids was created by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and featured in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure ''[[Jedi Code: The Way of the Force|The Way of the Force]]''. In the adventure the players [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-play]] as the Heroes of Cularin, and it is possible for the player characters to be members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The test was later mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and referred to the agents participating in the battle as "Jedi Knights", thus confirming that the members of the Heroes of Cularin that participated in the test were Jedi.
